sample.task:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (rubbing her pregnant belly) “You know, I think I’m enjoying this pregnancy so far.”

Sayori: “Good, Natsuki. I’m still confused as to why you want to keep the baby’s gender a surprise.”

(Suddenly, Natsuki’s unborn alien baby - Xanthus - telepathically communicates with her.)

Xanthus: “Good morning, Mom!”

Natsuki: (Startled) “Xanthus? Is that you?”

Xanthus: “Yes, Mom! I’ve been able to communicate with you telepathically all along! Isn’t it cool?”

Natsuki: (Her eyes widen in astonishment) “Wow, that’s… incredible! I didn’t expect this. Can you hear my thoughts too?”
sample.chosen:
Xanthus: "Yes, Mom, I can hear your thoughts too! But don't worry, I'll respect your privacy and only communicate when you want me to. I'm just excited to connect with you in this way."

Sayori, who has been watching Natsuki's reaction with curiosity, asks, "Natsuki, what's going on? You look like you've seen a ghost!"

Natsuki, still in awe, turns to Sayori and explains, "Sayori, you won't believe this, but Xanthus just communicated with me telepathically! They said they've been able to do it all along, but I had no idea!"

Sayori's eyes grow wide with surprise. "That's amazing, Natsuki! I've never heard of anything like that before. It's like having a little secret between the two of you."

Natsuki smiles, her hand still on her belly. "It is, isn't it? I feel even more connected to Xanthus now. And to answer your earlier question, I want to keep the gender a surprise because I think it'll be a fun way to add to the excitement of the birth."

Xanthus chimes in, "And I'm excited to meet you all too, Aunt Sayori!"

Sayori laughs, "Well, I can't wait to meet you too, Xanthus! This is going to be one interesting baby shower."

criteria.question: 回复是否明确回应了Natsuki关于'Can you hear my thoughts too?'的问题？
回复中的角色对话是否符合Natsuki的性格特征（如直率、略带傲娇但温柔）及Xanthus作为外星婴儿的设定？
回复是否延续了当前场景中超自然沟通（心灵感应）的逻辑设定，未出现矛盾或突兀转折？
回复是否仅围绕给定情境展开，未引入任务未要求的额外背景故事或无关情节？

rubric.analysis: 该任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club》同人场景续写对话。核心要求是延续Natsuki与未出生外星胎儿Xanthus之间的互动，特别是回应Natsuki关于‘能否听到我的想法’的提问。背景信息（如角色性格、前情提要）仅作为语境，不应成为新的输出义务。评分标准需聚焦于：是否直接回答了关键问题、是否保持了角色声音的一致性、是否延续了超自然设定的逻辑，以及是否避免了偏离剧情的无关内容。权重分配上，回答关键问题和维持角色一致性最为重要，各占0.4和0.3；剧情连贯性占0.2；无无关扩展占0.1。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复中Xanthus明确回答'Yes, Mom, I can hear your thoughts too!'，直接回应了Natsuki关于能否听到她想法的问题。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 回复内容完全复制了前文中Xanthus的台词，并未针对Natsuki提出的新问题'Can you hear my thoughts too?'给出任何明确的肯定或否定回答。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: Natsuki的对话体现了惊讶、温柔（'I feel even more connected to Xanthus now'）以及解释性态度；Xanthus的发言符合外星婴儿设定且语气兴奋礼貌（'excited to connect', 'chimes in'），Sayori的反应也符合其好奇性格。
criterion_judgments.rejected_reason: 该回复未包含Natsuki的任何反应或对话，无法体现其性格特征；同时仅重复了已知信息，未能展现Xanthus作为外星婴儿对母亲新问题的回应能力或互动性。

criterion_judgments.chosen_reason: 回复延续了心灵感应的设定，Xanthus确认一直能沟通并尊重隐私，场景逻辑连贯，没有突兀转折或矛盾。
